name: What is the typical timeframe for ordering and installing noise reduction windows?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeframe for ordering and installing noise reduction windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe for ordering and installing noise reduction windows can vary. After an initial consultation and measurement, manufacturing custom windows typically takes several weeks, depending on the specific features and current demand. Once the windows arrive, the installation itself usually takes a few days for an average-sized home, though this can extend for larger projects. We provide a detailed timeline after the initial assessment to manage expectations.
